Package index

Format inputs

Build or import the list of missing taxa and the total richness of clades.

import_taxonomic_table()
Import an external taxonomic table as a data frame
build_missing_taxa_list_from_taxonomy()
Build a missing_taxa_list from taxonomic tables
build_missing_taxa_list()
Build a missing_taxa_list from an internal data.frame of missing taxa
import_missing_taxa_list()
Import an external table of missing taxa as a missing_taxa_list object
convert_nodes_to_tips()
Convert the MRCA node IDs of a missing_taxa_list into tips
build_total_richness_per_clades()
Build the total_richness_per_clades object from a table of clades
import_total_richness_per_clades()
Import an external table of clades as total_richness_per_clades objects

Prepare species attributes

Prepare stochastic maps (simmaps) used to constrain grafting.

convert_contMap_to_simmap()
Convert contMap(s) of a continuous trait into simmap(s) with discrete states
convert_values_to_states()
Convert continuous trait values into the states of a discretized trait

Graft missing lineages

Graft missing taxa and/or missing clades on a backbone phylogeny.

graft_missing_taxa()
Graft missing taxa on a time-calibrated phylogeny
graft_missing_clades()
Graft missing clades on a time-calibrated phylogeny
graft_missing_taxa_and_clades()
Graft missing taxa and missing clades on a time-calibrated phylogeny

Check grafting and extract information

Check the grafting plan before grafting and the constraints after grafting, and extract information on the grafted phylogenies.

check_grafting_plan()
Check the feasibility of a grafting plan before grafting
check_grafting_constraints()
Check that grafted taxa and missing clades respect their grafting constraints
extract_grafting_info()
Extract the grafting information from grafted phylogenies
extract_sampling_info()
Extract the richness and sampling fraction of clades from grafted phylogenies
extract_BD_model_summary()
Extract the birth-death models fitted during grafting

Handle grafted phylogenies

Identify grafted elements, flatten sets of grafted phylogenies, and plot them.

identify_grafted()
Identify the grafted tips and branches of a phylogeny
flatten_grafted_phylogenies()
Flatten grafted phylogenies into a single set of phylogenies
plot_grafted()
Plot a grafted phylogeny with the grafted taxa highlighted

Datasets

Toy datasets used to run examples and tutorials.

toy_backbone
Toy backbone phylogeny
toy_contMap
Toy contMap of a continuous trait
toy_contMaps
Toy list of contMaps: stochastic histories of a continuous trait
toy_missing_taxa_list
Toy list of missing taxa
toy_missing_taxa_list_with_allowed_ranges
Toy list of missing taxa, with allowed ranges
toy_missing_taxa_list_with_allowed_states
Toy list of missing taxa, with allowed states
toy_missing_taxa_list_with_ranges_and_elevation
Toy list of missing taxa, with allowed states of two traits: biogeographic ranges and elevation
toy_missing_taxa_list_with_two_traits
Toy list of missing taxa, with allowed states of two traits: colors and elevation
toy_multiSimmap
Toy multiSimmap of a categorical trait: stochastic maps of the colors
toy_multiSimmap_elevation
Toy multiSimmap of a binary trait: stochastic maps of the elevation
toy_multiSimmap_ranges
Toy multiSimmap of biogeographic ranges
toy_simmap
Toy stochastic character map of the toy backbone phylogeny
toy_simmap_elevation
Toy stochastic character map of elevation states
toy_simmap_ranges
Toy stochastic character map of biogeographic ranges of the toy backbone phylogeny
toy_backbone_taxonomic_table toy_missing_taxa_taxonomic_table
Toy taxonomic tables
toy_tip_data
Toy tip data of three species attributes
toy_tip_values
Toy tip values of a continuous trait
toy_total_richness_per_clades
Toy total richness of the target clades
